03 · Literature Connection — 15 minutes

Meet Jules Verne

Jules Verne (1828–1905) was a French novelist famous for adventure stories inspired by science, geography and technological progress. His novel Around the World in Eighty Days was published in 1872.

Book trailer · A journey against the clock

Scene 1 — The bet. In London, Phileas Fogg bets that he can travel around the world in just 80 days.

Scene 2 — The journey. Fogg and Passepartout travel by trains and steamships. They face delays, unexpected problems and difficult decisions.

Scene 3 — The race. Every hour matters. Will Fogg return to London in time?

Scene 4 — The question for us. What would change if Fogg planned his journey with smartphones, online bookings and AI?

This is a classroom summary of the story, not a quotation from the novel.

Read the original book for free · Project Gutenberg ↗

04 · Reading — 15 minutes

From Travel Agencies to Big Data

In the 1980s, many tourists visited travel agencies to book flights, hotels and organized tours. Agents used printed brochures, telephone calls and reservation systems. Comparing different offers often took time.

Today, travelers can research destinations, compare prices and book accommodation online. Reviews and social media can influence decisions. Tourism companies have also started using data to understand customer preferences and improve their services.

However, digital transformation has created new challenges. Online information is not always reliable, personal data must be protected, and some travelers need accessible alternatives to digital-only services. At the same time, sustainable tourism and wellness travel have become important industry trends.

In the future, AI tools may help visitors design personalized itineraries. Tourism businesses will need to combine technology with human communication, accessibility and environmental responsibility.

05 · Grammar Discovery — 15 minutes

Read the examples. Explain the difference to your teacher.

StructureExampleMeaning / Use
Present Perfect
have/has + past participle		Tourism has changed dramatically.Past changes connected to the present. / Cambios con impacto actual.
will + verbTravelers will use more digital services.Prediction or opinion about the future. / Predicción.
be going to + verbThe agency is going to launch an app.Existing plan or intention. / Plan decidido.
may / might + verbAI might change tour guiding.Possibility, not certainty. / Posibilidad.

Explain: Why does the reading say “AI tools may help” instead of “AI tools will help”?

1. Tourism ______ significantly since the 1980s.
2. We have already decided: our company ______ create a new website.
3. It is possible that virtual tours ______ become more popular.

06 · Professional Challenge — 20 minutes

Case: Puerto Madryn Tourism 2035. A local travel agency has worked with traditional bookings for many years. It wants to attract new visitors, improve accessibility and become more sustainable without losing personal customer service.

Your role: You are tourism consultants. In pairs or small groups, prepare four recommendations.

  1. Identify two changes in the tourism industry since the 1980s.
  2. Choose one current trend (sustainable, wellness or accessible tourism) and explain its value for Puerto Madryn.
  3. Recommend one digital improvement for the agency.
  4. Make two predictions about tourism in 2035, using different structures.

Model: “Tourists have started using online reviews to choose services. Our agency is going to improve its website. In 2035, visitors might use AI to plan personalized wildlife tours.”
